title: How much does the British Royal Family cost taxpayers? King Charles' £137.9m grant, William's wealth
summary_full: The British Royal Family receives £137.9 million through the Sovereign Grant in 2026/27, but a new bill proposes reducing the funding to £99.9 million the following year. Meanwhile, reports reveal Prince William’s £1.2 billion Duchy of Cornwall valuation and King Charles’ estimated £640 million fortune, raising questions about royal wealth, income and taxes.
